calls.title: May 20, 10:16 AM
calls.summary: The team addressed a critical issue where some users were exposed to multiple variants within Growthbook experiments, particularly affecting 14 users. Chris Sanders identified the root cause as mismatches in user IDs during experiment bucketing, stemming from inconsistent hashing inputs. A suspicious race condition was discussed, where the SDK might initialize before cookies were set, leading to variations in ID usage. To confirm these inconsistencies, the team planned to enhance logging for user IDs during SDK initialization and tracking callbacks. They agreed to reconvene the following day to review log findings and work towards addressing these integrity issues that impact production data.
calls.keywords: Multiple Exposure, Growthbook, SDK Initialization, User ID Consistency, Cookie Management, Experiment Bucketing
calls.action_items:
**Sanjai Prabahar Krishnamurthi**
Add logging to capture and compare user ID used at Growthbook SDK initialization and tracking callback to detect ID mismatches causing multiple exposures (17:44)
Run tests and collect consolidated server-side logs (e.g., Splunk or app insights) around Growthbook user ID across experiment lifecycle for verification (01:14:07)
Validate that cookie values are consistent and present before Growthbook SDK initialization for stable bucketing (29:57)
Share test results and logs with Chris Sanders prior to follow-up meeting (01:19:27)
Investigate possibility of evaluating experiments server-side and passing experiment keys and variation values to the client for UI use to reduce race condition risks (01:15:14)

**Jeyachandiran Paramasivam**
Support Sanjai in verifying data in BigQuery experiments query results, expanding columns including GB ID, user ID, experiment variation, and timestamps to correlate data for root cause analysis (59:38)
Coordinate scheduling of follow-up meeting with Chris Sanders and team after logs are collected (01:18:45)
Assist in reviewing client-side script loading and initialization process and verify correct cookie usage in initialization and tracking callbacks (48:38)

**Chris Sanders**
Explain hashing and bucketing mechanism and how race conditions or differing user IDs during SDK init vs tracking cause multiple variant assignment (06:28)
Recommend using Growthbook plugin for client-side debugging and emphasize importance of ensuring consistent user ID across init and tracking callback (32:49)
Suggest using the same initialized SDK ID value for event tracking callbacks instead of repeatedly fetching cookie values (48:51)
Confirm feasibility of server-side evaluation of experiments and callback execution (01:15:14)
Coordinate next meeting after receiving logs and provide further troubleshooting support (01:19:10)
